notes: Planner Health + Prompt Budget + Settlement Timeline: citizen decision prompts are now built against an explicit token budget inside an 8192-token context window (previously 4096, which long-running cities could silently overflow). When the budget is tight, older memory lines are condensed; identity, rules, vitals, and legal actions are never cut. Confirmed-deposit and validated-property lists are now bounded. Every planning attempt is recorded (chosen, refused by Simulation, or lost to an Ollama/JSON/truncation failure) with the real prompt size, failures are written to the server log, and Admin System Health shows a Citizen decisions row. Records gains a read-only Timeline tab: totals, activity per period, starter stores then vs now, per-citizen totals, and filterable milestones from public records only. No Simulation authority, citizen behavior rules, world truth, or autonomy changes.
